screen28-a1.glyph: X made of two crossed diagonal lines
screen28-a1.description: X glyph at the top-left of the full-height plan sheet
screen28-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Close" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen28-a1.convention_relied_on: an X is an established close convention — my reading, confidence high
screen28-a1.initial_rationale: close convention on a full-height sheet; exemption pending the behavioural test
screen28-a1.deciding_evidence: same control as screen4-a1 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: the X closed the sheet

screen28-a2.description: Pro plan option card with a radio button, '$20.00 Billed monthly'
screen28-a2.visible_text: "$20.00" "Billed monthly", under the heading "Pro — For everyday productivity"
screen28-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "$20.00 Billed monthly" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen28-a2.initial_rationale: radio card inside a Pro section with price and billing period; plainly a choice of how to pay for Pro
screen28-a2.deciding_evidence: same control as screen4-a2 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: price, billing period and the section heading together say what choosing it means; no test required

screen28-a3.description: Pro plan option card with a radio button, 'Save 10% $216.00 Billed annually'
screen28-a3.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Save 10% $216.00 Billed annually" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen28-a3.initial_rationale: radio card with price, billing period and saving; plainly the annual option of Pro
screen28-a3.deciding_evidence: same control as screen4-a3 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: the card's own words state price, period and saving; the optional selection test was blocked but no test is required for a Clear verdict

screen28-a4.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Get Pro plan" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen28-a4.initial_rationale: explicit action tied to the Pro section and the selected price
screen28-a4.deciding_evidence: same control as screen4-a4 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: the words say exactly what it does; not pressed because it starts a purchase flow; no test required

screen28-a5.description: underlined 'Limits apply' link at the end of the Pro feature list
screen28-a5.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Limits apply for Pro" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen28-a5.initial_rationale: the words state a fact, not an action; they do not say which limits, or that tapping shows them, or where it goes
screen28-a5.deciding_evidence: same control as screen4-a5 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: a statement used as a link hands the user to another app without saying so or saying what it will show
screen28-a5.recommendation: make it an action with its destination, e.g. 'See Pro usage limits (opens web page)'

screen28-a6.description: Max plan option card with a radio button, '$125.00', cut off by the bottom edge
screen28-a6.visible_text: "$125.00" under "Max — More time with Claude"; the caption below the price is off-screen
screen28-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "$125.00 5x more usage than Pro" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen28-a6.initial_rationale: only a price is visible; what distinguishes it from the $250.00 card beside it is off-screen
screen28-a6.deciding_evidence: same control as screen4-a6 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: one scroll reveals the caption stating what the option gives and how it is billed; the clipping is a crop of the capture, not a missing label

screen28-a7.description: Max plan option card with a radio button, '$250.00', cut off by the bottom edge
screen28-a7.visible_text: "$250.00" under "Max — More time with Claude"; the caption below the price is off-screen
screen28-a7.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "$250.00 20x more usage than Pro" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen28-a7.initial_rationale: only a price is visible; what distinguishes it from the $125.00 card is off-screen
screen28-a7.deciding_evidence: same control as screen4-a7 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: tested together with the $125.00 card on screen4-a6: one scroll reveals '20x more usage than Pro / Billed monthly'
